project_context.vibe: Scandinavian minimalist workplace tool. Grounded, matte, physical, clean, fast. Designed for grocery store workers.

rules.h1: font-chivo text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none text-stone-900
rules.h2: font-chivo text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-stone-900
rules.label_overline: font-work text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-stone-500

backgrounds.scanner_overlay: bg-black/90 - For the camera viewfinder background.

brand_accents.primary: bg-[#2A3B32] text-white - Deep forest green. High contrast against kraft paper.
brand_accents.secondary: bg-[#D4A373] text-stone-900 - Kraft paper brown. Use for tags or secondary highlights.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Mobile-first 'Control Room' grid. Dense but tap-friendly. Generous padding inside containers.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl (applies a slightly soft but modern edge, max 16px).

grid_patterns.bottom_nav: flex justify-around items-center h-20 bg-white border-t border-stone-200 pb-safe

surface_strategies.cards: Flat Solid. bg-white border border-stone-200 shadow-sm. NO glassmorphism. It must feel tactile and real.
surface_strategies.floating_action_button: Solid shadow-lg bg-[#2A3B32] text-white rounded-full h-16 w-16 flex items-center justify-center fixed bottom-24 right-6 z-50.
surface_strategies.header: Solid bg-[#F9F8F6] z-40 sticky top-0 pb-4 pt-6

buttons.primary: h-14 px-8 rounded-xl bg-[#2A3B32] text-white font-chivo font-bold text-lg transition-transform active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: h-14 px-8 rounded-xl bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-900 font-chivo font-bold text-lg transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.counter_adjust: h-12 w-12 rounded-lg bg-stone-100 text-stone-900 flex items-center justify-center active:bg-stone-200 transition-colors

components.inputs: h-14 bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 font-work text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2A3B32] outline-none
components.bottom_sheet_modal: Shadcn Dialog/Drawer customized. bg-white rounded-t-3xl p-6

motion.micro_interactions: Fast and responsive. active:scale-[0.98] on all clickable items.
motion.loading_state: When AI is counting: A fullscreen semi-transparent overlay with a minimal scanning line animation over the image and a text like 'Analyserar...'.

empty_state_bg.description: Minimal brown paper texture. Can be used at 10% opacity as a background element for empty states or onboarding.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Ensure you update index.css to import Chivo and Work Sans, and update tailwind.config.js font families.
TESTING: Every interactive element MUST have a kebab-case role-based 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='take-photo-button', data-testid='increment-small-bag').

MOCK AI: Since this is an MVP, the camera action should open a standard file input (or use navigator.mediaDevices if possible), then simulate a 3-second loading state, and return mock counts populated into the categories.
LOCAL STORAGE: Save daily history and bag types (compartments) in localStorage so the app works without login and persists data.

LAYOUT: Must be strictly mobile-first. Max-width on desktop should be constrained (e.g. max-w-md mx-auto) to mimic a mobile app view, or adapt gracefully to a multi-column 'Control Room' dashboard on wide screens.
AESTHETIC: Avoid purple/teal generic SaaS styles. Stick to the stone-50 background, white cards, and deep forest green primary buttons. It should feel like a physical, premium inventory tool.
